title: A new family of distances over partially ordered sets
summary: Order theory is increasingly relevant in applications where data is naturally structured as a partially ordered set (poset), often requiring meaningful notions of distance over posets. In this paper, we introduce a new family of extended metrics on path-connected and fence-connected posets that do not require additional structure. Unlike many existing distances, these metrics are not induced by valuations, but instead arise as a type of shortest-path distance determined by both path length and the number of alternations.
